title: Financial Assistance Terms: Hardship Relief Share on Charges Enrolled in Patient Payment Plans
content:
A hardship approval on the patient's Patient Financial Account limits how much of a charge's remaining balance a proposed Patient Payment Plans plan carries, when the charge is one posted for an encounter already enrolled on that plan.

**Term.** Where the financial account holds a hardship approval whose approved-through date is on or after the charge's date of service and shows no hardship adjustment on the charge, the plan carries only a relief share of the remaining balance: 0.50 when the approval is at least 50 percent, 0.75 when it is above 0.00 but below 50 percent. In every other case the relief share is 1.

**Effect.** The relief share multiplies the charge's remaining balance, without intermediate rounding. The part of the remaining balance outside the relief share is left on the financial account for the business office to adjust under the hardship decision.

**Records read.** The approved hardship percentage and approved-through date on the Patient Financial Account, the charge's date of service, and any hardship adjustment the account shows on that charge.

| Approved percentage | Approved-through date on or after the date of service | Hardship adjustment already on the charge | Relief share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 or more | Yes | No | 0.50 |
| Above 0.00, below 50 | Yes | No | 0.75 |
| Above 0.00 | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Above 0.00 | No | Any | 1 |
| 0.00 (no approval) | Any | Any | 1 |

**Examples (hypothetical).**

- Approval of 60 percent through 31 December; charge with a date of service of 5 November, no hardship adjustment, remaining balance 400.00: the relief share is 0.50, the plan carries 200.00 of it, and 200.00 is left on the financial account for the business office.
- The same approval and a charge with a date of service of 10 January of the following year: the approval does not reach the date of service; the relief share is 1.
- An approval of exactly 50 percent covering the date of service: at least 50 percent, so 0.50.
